skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Recognize vocabulary in the field of human resource management.
Identify context and purpose of communication in written form within the field of human resource management.
Understand and express the meaning of specialized vocabulary and phrases in the field of human resource management.
Analyze and evaluate the effectiveness of specialized vocabulary used in human resource management texts.
Create appropriate English texts for specific communication requirements and purposes in the field of human resource management.
Formulate basic questions related to vocabulary and grammar in English texts about human resource management.
Apply specialized vocabulary in writing and reading English texts in the field of human resource management in different contexts.
Use specialized vocabulary flexibly and accurately in writing, reading, and other information sources in the field of human resource management.
Evaluate and improve English texts using specialized vocabulary in the field of human resource management to convey information accurately and effectively.
